business_problem: Moderna needed to reduce the time and effort of manually extracting, validating, and transforming large real-world datasets from many public and private sources. Its teams were writing custom onboarding code and scripts for each new source, dealing with siloed data that lacked traceability, and managing separate vendor billing processes that slowed data access and made it harder for scientists and stakeholders to get trusted information where it was needed most.
solution_summary: Moderna standardized its real-world data strategy on AWS by combining AWS Data Exchange, AWS Marketplace, TetraScience Data Cloud, Amazon S3, and Amazon Redshift. AWS Data Exchange became the control point for sourcing and subscribing to third-party healthcare datasets, while AWS Marketplace simplified procurement and onboarding for supporting SaaS solutions such as TetraScience Data Cloud. Moderna used TetraScience to automate and centralize ingestion from disparate laboratory instruments, software systems, and external data sources, then stored curated data in Amazon S3 data lakes. Data is made directly accessible in Amazon Redshift for near-real-time analysis in disease-surveillance dashboards and business intelligence workflows, giving researchers and trial teams faster access to harmonized data without custom integrations for every provider.

solution_components.name: AWS Marketplace
solution_components.role: Provides a controlled procurement channel for third-party data or software services.

solution_components.name: AWS Data Exchange
solution_components.role: Brings third-party datasets into the customer data platform with controlled subscriptions.

solution_components.name: TetraScience Data Cloud
solution_components.role: Automates and centralizes ingestion, verification, enrichment, and harmonization of data from disparate lab and software sources.

solution_components.name: Amazon S3
solution_components.role: Stores raw, intermediate, or curated files and datasets.

solution_components.name: Amazon Redshift
solution_components.role: Stores analytical data and powers warehouse-style querying for reporting or ML features.

data_flow: Third-party real-world data is sourced through AWS Data Exchange, while laboratory and software data is centralized through TetraScience Data Cloud procured on AWS Marketplace. Moderna stores curated data in Amazon S3 data lakes, makes it directly accessible in Amazon Redshift, and updates dashboards and business intelligence workflows in near real time for research and enrollment decisions.
business_outcome: Moderna accelerated data acquisition from 8–10 days to 3 days, enabled stakeholders to make business decisions 70 percent faster, simplified procurement and billing for data and SaaS providers, and gave researchers near-real-time access to harmonized real-world data for enrollment, disease surveillance, and scientific workflows.
